description: Repairs r-fmt-2b/fx-byte-update: the read of every row failed on the unreadable Decimal Fm (hr 0x80020009, -1038), so the record is ReturnedFailure. Which bytes of the closed file change when one one-byte fixed field (Fx.Fb, Byte) of row 5 is updated to a different value by UPDATE with dbFailOnError? Fx: ten rows on one small table (ID Long key; Byte Fb, Long Fl, Currency Fc, Date Ft, GUID Fg, a Text Vt and Decimal Fm made by ADO DDL as DECIMAL(28,0), so DAO can read it); row 8 is Null in Fb, Fl, Fc, Ft and Fm; elsewhere Fm = ID * 100. Images: 'before' (the fixture copy as given), then one kept image of the closed file after each step; every step opens the database read/write, makes its mutation and closes it, with the DBEngine still alive.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-fmt-sort probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
